verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Kimi's coding agent can read code, edit files and run commands inside a local project folder or terminal. That is a coding and shell capability, not the assistant seeing and operating desktop applications. The browser-extension entry is only a help-page title, with no description of observing or controlling apps, so there is no documented computer-use capability.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can let the assistant see and operate applications on my computer to complete work
